title: QA verdict review
summary: A resolved QA review tells the current item claim holder its outcome, reviewer note and next action. An unheld item routes to steering; pending session notices remain visible there. Deployment requirements retain run/stage routing. The delivery-flow pipeline labels each QA policy Approval: no human approval required, human approval required, or human approval required if the agent is unsure. Human policies retain their reviewer names; this wording does not change the policy.
